description.en-US: Volume 5 of the English Liturgical Year (Lent), translated from L’Année liturgique: one chapter per day or feast, with the Latin liturgical texts beside their English. Made from the Internet Archive scan of the 1912 printing; the two-column Latin and English text is separated by script, so some lines may be misassigned.
description.pt-BR: Volume 5 do «Liturgical Year» em inglês (Quaresma), traduzido de L’Année liturgique: um capítulo por dia ou festa, com os textos litúrgicos em latim ao lado do inglês.

sources.edition: The Liturgical Year, Lent, translated from the French of Dom Prosper Guéranger; printing of 1912 (Stanbrook Abbey / Duffy). Internet Archive scan, OCR text.
sources.description: Split at each day or feast heading detected in the running text; running heads and page numbers removed; the Latin and English columns of the liturgical texts, interleaved line by line in the OCR, were separated by language and set as a Latin paragraph followed by its English.
sources.tierEvidence: Guéranger (d. 1875) and the translation printed 1870-1912: public domain.
